artworks.title: Lady with Ribbons on Curls
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The person faces forward with their head slightly turned to the left. They have a calm expression and long curly hair styled back. The person wears a dress with a lace-trimmed wide neckline and a dark ribbon bow. They have a choker necklace made of pearls. The background is a plain textured surface, and the portrait is in a circular border.

artworks.title: Woman with White Veil and Black Hat (Mary Stuart?)
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a woman in a black and white etching. Her head is turned slightly to her left, with a straight nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and direct eyes. She has neatly styled hair and wears a detailed garment with a high collar and a necklace. The background consists of densely hatched lines, typical of traditional etchings.

artworks.title: Duchess of Lennox
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper portion of a woman's body. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to the left. The woman has distinct facial features with almond-shaped eyes and a calm expression. Her curly hair flows down her shoulders, and she wears a headband or covering. She is dressed in period clothing with an open square neckline adorned with a brooch. She wears a pearl necklace and earrings. The background is plain to emphasize the woman's detailed portrait.

artworks.title: Man with Beard Looking Right (Hans Holbein?)
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in profile, turned slightly to the right. The man has a full, curly beard and a mustache, with a stern expression on his face. His eyes are looking off into the distance. He is wearing a hat, a detailed garment with a high collar, and a draped outer cloak. A hand is visible holding onto the cloak near his chest. The background is plain, with a monochrome backdrop. There is script in the upper left corner containing names and a date.

artworks.title: Head of Woman Looking Right
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Lorenzo di Credi
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing forward from the chest upwards. They have long, straight hair and delicate facial features, including wide eyes and a composed expression. The individual wears a simple garment with a patterned neckline and a double-stranded necklace. The background is lightly textured. On the top left and right, there are inscriptions indicating the name "Lorenzo di Credi im." and "W. Holler fecd. 1645, 2 January."

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting the bust of a man within an ornate oval frame. The man is facing the viewer directly with his torso and head visible. He has shoulder-length wavy hair, a prominent nose, and a mustache. He is dressed in a dark garment with a white collar and visible buttons. The frame surrounding the portrait is ornate with swirling designs and a shield-like emblem at the bottom featuring a fleur-de-lis and a mountain design. Above the portrait, inscribed within the frame are the words "Ætatis 40. 1647." The background of the image is plain. At the bottom of the frame, the name “Wenceslaus Hollar” is displayed.

artworks.title: Summer: The Bathing Place
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with buildings, trees, and a church steeple in the distance. The architectural details are intricately drawn in fine lines. The color scheme is primarily sepia. People can be seen swimming and boating in the water, with some small boats present. The riverbank is populated with figures, possibly socializing. In the background, there is a picturesque European town. The sky is depicted with thin lines and scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Johann Banfi Huniades
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Jacob Peter Gowy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarter view facing left. He has distinct facial features, including a pointed moustache and a short beard. His hair is medium length, seemingly wavy, and brushed forward. The man is dressed in a detailed garment featuring a fitted bodice with buttons on the sleeve, a wide lace collar, and patterned textures. He is holding a spherical object in his left hand. The background consists of an ornate oval frame with elaborate scrolls and a globe depicted at the top. Latin inscriptions surround the frame, adding a scholarly context to the image. The artwork is engraved and displays a high level of detail in the clothing and facial features of the subject as well as the framing elements.

artworks.title: Standing Figure
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their body facing slightly to one side. Their head is turned towards the viewer, while their extended arm gestures outward to the side. The person's facial features are delicately rendered with subtle shading, and their hair is styled in a swept-back manner with gentle waves. They are draped in a garment that flows elegantly over their body, creating a sense of smooth, cascading fabric folds. No jewelry or objects are visibly held or worn by the person. The background is plain, with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has curly shoulder-length hair, a mustache, and a contemplative expression. He wears 17th-century clothing with a dark-colored garment and a flat white collar. The portrait is framed with ornate scrollwork and a heraldic shield at the bottom featuring two lions and a fleur-de-lis design. The background is plain. The drawing includes the inscription "Etatis 40. 1647."

artworks.title: View of Shenckenschantz
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with sailboats on water. A sailboat is prominent on the right with its sails raised. In the background, there is a flat land with a fortified structure labeled "Schenckenschantz." The etching technique uses fine lines with a monochrome color palette of black, gray, and creamy hues. The artwork emphasizes linework, with detailed cross-hatching and parallel lines for shading and depth.

artworks.title: Execution of Thomas Wentworth
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene depicting an execution event. The composition centers around a platform surrounded by dense crowds of figures witnessing the event, with the architectural backdrop dominated by a large fortress-like building. The intricate crowd scene shows the multitude of spectators and some individuals standing on the platform. Above the scene, dark cloudy skies loom, enhancing the somber atmosphere. The overall style and detail of the drawing suggest a work from the early to mid-17th century, capturing a notable historical event with precision and dramatic intensity.

artworks.title: Interior of the Church of Saint Katherine with Parable of the Pharisee and the Publican
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.4 x 19.7 cm (11 3/16 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a Gothic church or cathedral. The drawing captures the intricate architecture of a sacred space characterized by tall, vaulted ceilings and massive columns. The arches are adorned with sculptures of angels and religious figures, as well as designs. Light filters through stained glass windows, producing an ethereal effect. One statue is on a tall pedestal on the left, and another figure is kneeling on the floor. The floor consists of square tiles, and a cat is walking on them. The composition is detailed, illustrating the grandeur and solemnity of a place of worship from the medieval period.

artworks.title: The Great Cannon
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed, intricately etched scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. In the foreground, a group of figures stands near a cannon on a wheeled carriage. To the left, a figure works near a large tree. Beyond this, there are thatched-roof buildings, a village road, and a church spire in the distance. Hills and a cloudy sky can be seen on the horizon. The artwork features fine linework, cross-hatching, and stippling for textures and depth. The monochrome brown color palette gives the scene an antique quality.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.4 x 15.7 cm (8 13/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's upper body, focusing on their head and shoulders. The individual is positioned in a formal pose, facing to the right. They have a prominent, straight nose, a slightly pointed chin, and full lips. The person's hair is styled with an angular cut and is visible underneath a large, brimmed hat adorned with a decorative medallion or brooch on the side. The person is dressed in elaborate clothing featuring an intricately patterned cloak or mantle and a similarly ornate visible collar or robe beneath. Around their neck, a chain or necklace is displayed, ending in a pendant with a heraldic motif. The background is richly detailed with a floral and vine pattern, set within a textured border, complementing the elegant attire of the figure. The script at the bottom of the image appears to be a formal inscription.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Erasmus of Rotterdam, displaying his upper body and head in profile, facing right. It shows his distinguished forehead, prominent nose, and pronounced chin. He wears a soft cap, partially covering his hair, with a few strands visible. Erasmus is dressed in a cloak with a fur collar. There is a sculptural bust with another profile facing right with curly hair. The background includes text that says "ERASMVS ROTERODAMVS" and other inscriptions, adding to the historical and scholarly context. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Baptism
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures, showing their bodies from head to mid-thigh. The central figure stands in a river with arms crossed over the chest. They have a gentle facial expression with long hair and a beard, while a cloth is draped loosely around the waist. To the left, a figure is kneeling in the river, wearing a brown garment with horizontal stripes and a rope tied around the waist, and pouring water over the central figure's head. This person has a full beard and curly hair. The third figure, on the right, stands with one hand resting on the shoulder of the central figure, clothed in a red robe with long blond hair and a small crown on the head. In the background, billowing blue clouds fill the sky above a green landscape, enhancing the serene setting.

artworks.title: Antique Shop
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an entrance to an open area, potentially a courtyard, surrounded by buildings. The architecture features large rectangular windows, giving a sense of height and structure. The horizon is obscured by the facades of the buildings in the background. The artwork showcases detailed etching with a focus on line work to depict texture and detail, particularly in the windows and rooftops. The color scheme is monochromatic, using only black and white tones to enhance the dramatic and historic atmosphere. The foreground includes an entrance with various objects, leading the viewer's gaze further into the scene to explore the architectural elements. In the distance, the alleyway and buildings are depicted with shading and fine lines, creating a visually rich composition.

artworks.title: Adriaen van Ostade
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a man with his arms crossed, looking slightly to his right. He wears a broad-brimmed hat, and his hair reaches his collar. He has prominent cheekbones and slightly narrowed eyes, and wears a collared garment with large cuffs. In front of him is a nude child figure interacting with a large sheet of paper or artwork. The surroundings include a shelf with a bottle and a framed image, all set against a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Sylvester (Douglas) Lord Glenbervie; Katherine Anne (North) Glenbervie; Frederic (North) Earl of Guilford; Frederic Sylvester Douglas
artworks.medium: lithograph, four portraits printed on one sheet
artworks.description: This image is a composite of four sketched portraits, each showing the upper half of the individuals in a seated position. The first portrait, in the upper left, depicts Katherine Anne (North), Lady Glenbervie. She is seated with her body turned toward the viewer, and her facial features include large eyes and delicate lips. Her hair is covered by a bonnet with frills and a feather. She wears a high-collared dress with intricate detailing on the sleeves. The second portrait, in the upper right, features Sylvester (Douglas), Lord Glenbervie. He sits sideways with his body angled to the right, displaying features like a strong nose and a high forehead with sparse hair. He is dressed in a formal coat and vest. The third portrait, on the lower left, is of The Honorable Frederic Sylvester Douglas. His hair is neatly styled, and he wears a buttoned coat. Lastly, the fourth portrait on the lower right showcases Frederic (North), Earl of Guildford. He is seated facing forward with a relaxed demeanor, his hair parted. His attire includes a double-breasted coat and gloves. The background for all portraits is plain.

artworks.title: Four Magistrates of Besançon (Quatre magistrats de Besançon)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal scene set within a decorative framework. The image depicts four figures dressed in historical attire, each seated on ornate chairs underneath a draped canopy. The heraldic emblem featuring a double-headed eagle sits atop the tapestry. The figures appear to be engaged in a discussion or debate, with one gesturing towards the others.

artworks.title: Courthouse Portal, Rothenburgh
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate doorway with steps leading up to it. The drawing depicts a detailed and intricately carved entrance, showcasing architectural elements including archways and decorative stone carvings. The steps leading up to the doorway are uneven. A lantern hangs from a wrought iron bracket. The textures in the drawing highlight the ruggedness of the stone and the elaborate designs.

artworks.title: Abside de l'église de Saint-Nectaire
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is not clearly visible, with the focus on a church situated on a hill surrounded by hilly terrain. Additionally, there are cottages dispersed among rolling hills closer to the viewer. The lithograph depicts detailed and somewhat soft brushstrokes, blending natural forms and architecture harmoniously. The color scheme is predominantly monochromatic, using shades of gray to portray depth and form against a cloud-streaked sky.

artworks.title: Souvenir de St. Valéry sur Somme
artworks.description: The image shows a boat on the shore, with buildings and other boats in the background. Human figures are visible nearby. The sky above has swirling, textured clouds in shades of black, white, and gray.
